title: OscInt: uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in Lean 4 and Mathlib
description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in one and two variables: the one-dimensional van der Corput lemma with explicit constants; non-stationary and nondegenerate stationary phase uniform in a linear term; the uniform fold estimate m^{-5/6}; the uniform D4 (umbilic) estimate t^{-2/3} for both umbilics with the leading term t^{2/3}∫e^{itφ}A → c_C A(0) and its closed-form constant; front ends in Mathlib's idiom (local smoothness, compact families of phases); and global decay from a pointwise classification of the phase (nondegenerate, fold, or finitely many D4 points), with the dispersive estimate t^{-2/3} for the 2D lattice Laplacian and its sharpness. Statements are frozen and timestamped before their proofs, reviewed blind, and replayed by several independent kernels.
keywords: MSC2020: 68V20 Formalization of mathematics in connection with theorem provers
MSC2020: 03B35 Mechanization of proofs and logical operations
